scope: Local a2.pdf and the supplied MultiDroneUnc README; current report, source tree and recorded experiments.

requirements.requirement: One PDF and one source/test archive with a single top-level folder
Include all source codes and test cases used in the report
requirements.fix: Archived five historical planner sources; all six version hashes match the 19 experiment metadata files.

requirements.requirement: Disclose generative AI and provide the prompts used
Part A: abstraction, alpha-vector intervals/dominance, MDP/POMDP scenarios
B1: MDP formulation with known stochastic transitions
B2: specific approximate online solver, pseudocode and four MCTS components
B3: implement B2 with the supplied primitives; serial planning, up to 10 seconds per step
requirements.note: Initialisation is timed separately; existing default demos also stay below 10 seconds when setup is added to the first decision. These local measurements are not a hard real-time guarantee on other hardware.

requirements.requirement: B4: systematic state/action/clutter experiments, expectations, repeated runs, means and 95% CIs, component effects as complexity grows
requirements.note: State padding, changing control authority and one layout per generated (N, alpha) pair limit generalisation; the report states these limitations.

requirements.requirement: Canvas upload before the deadline; attend demo and oral Q&A
